# Should you buy a baler, or keep paying a custom baler by the bale?

> Free hay baling calculator: should you own a baler or hire a custom baler? Acres, yield, equipment cost, labour and the custom price per bale in; own vs hire cost, break-even acres, cost per bale and what to charge neighbours out. Nothing uploaded.

Free and open source (MIT). Results are estimates from the numbers typed in, not legal, tax, financial or professional advice.
